descriptionHtml: This is a robotics competition organized with collobaration of Electrical & Electronics Engineering Students society of University of Peradeniya. The participants were first year engineering undergraduates. About 250 students were participated in 30 groups. At the begining, an orientation session about IEEE was conducted by Mr. Yasitha Harshanath, one of the former SSR(2017) and Mr. Chanaka Hettige, the current(2019) SAC chair at Sri Lanka section. The competition was much interactive and winners were awarded with certificates.
